summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Solana Fund (FSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund aims to track the spot price performance of Solana (SOL), less fees and expenses. The Trust holds Solana, the native cryptocurrency of the Solana blockchain FSOL was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Fidelity.
